reviews.text: I ordered Alnut food from their website, which stated they offered delivery. When the delivery day arrived, nothing arrived. I contacted them via WhatsApp, and they told me they don't offer delivery, even though their website clearly states they do. I went to pick up the order at the Rafael Sanzio branch, and to my surprise, it was closed. I then had to go to the Providencia branch, and it turns out they were out of stock—a product I had already paid for. Please be more attentive to your services and don't waste people's time!
They don't know how to trim small dogs' nails and they don't tell you they cut them until they bled. The worst part is that there were two dogs and they went too far with both of them.

They do their job, but they don't seem interested in making the dogs feel comfortable. Their communication style creates a feeling of apathy towards people and their pets. It can be more expensive than other establishments.
Very bad service, very unprofessional, not at all reliable to take your pets there.
Great location, I buy my pet food there, great selection and good service.
